rows: Access permission faults are prioritized over unaligned device memory faults

Incorrect behavior of ICACHE refill from SRAM when an SRAM AHB error occurs
SRAMx_RST option bits have an immediate effect
Full JTAG configuration without NJTRST pin cannot be used
SRAM2 is erased when the backup domain is reset
Clearing WWDG_SW might result in debug authentication or STiRoT failure
LSE low drive mode is not functional
Debug not available when TrustZone® security is disabled and the PRODUCT_STATE is iROT-Provisioned
Low-speed external clock in analog bypass mode might not work properly
Octo-SPI memory data failure when using HCLK as kernel clock
PLL1P output can unduly be disabled by software when used as SYSCLK clock
ADC and DAC clock selection cannot be secured when the ADC is nonsecure
Reset vector catch feature cannot be used when debugging is disabled for secure code
Invalid DAC output voltage for several DAC kernel clocks
LPTIM2_CH1 might prevent the system from entering low-power modes

FDCAN TrustZone® protection not aligned with memory

Wrong data read from a busy NAND memory

TCF set twice on an abort

Indirect write mode limited to 256 Mbytes

Setting the ABORT bit does not generate an error on the AHB bus for undefined-length incremental burst transfers
Read data corruption when a wrap transaction is followed by a linear read to the same MSB address
Transactions are limited to 8 Mbytes in OctaRAM™ memories
Variable latency is not supported when a refresh collision occurs during a write ™access to some OctaRAM memories
Command response and receive data end bits not checked
New context conversion initiated without waiting for trigger when writing new context in ADC_JSQR with JQDIS = 0 and JQM = 0
Two consecutive context conversions fail when writing new context in ADC_JSQR just after previous context completion with JQDIS = 0 and JQM = 0
Unexpected regular conversion when two consecutive injected conversions are performed in Dual interleaved mode
Injected data stored in the wrong ADC_JDRx registers
ADC slave data may be shifted in Dual regular simultaneous mode
Output mode not usable with both PSSI_RDY and PSSI_DE signals enabled
Bidirectional break mode not working with short pulses

Timer connection to USB SOF might not work properly

ARRM and CMPM flags are not set when APB clock is slower than kernel clock
Interrupt status flag is cleared by hardware upon writing its corresponding bit in LPTIM_DIER register
PLL2 output cannot be used as LPTIM clock source
Independent watchdog does not wake up the system from Stop mode
Alarm flag may be repeatedly set when the core is stopped in debug
RTC wrong calendar read value through shadow registers
Timestamp flag unexpectedly raised when disabling timestamp
Wrong data sampling when data setup time (tSU;DAT) is shorter than one I2C kernel clock period
Spurious bus error detection in controller mode
SDA held low upon SMBus timeout expiry in target mode
I3C controller: unexpected read data bytes during a legacy I2C read
I3C controller: SCL clock is not stalled during address ACK/NACK phase following a frame start, when enabled through I3C_TIMINGR2 register
I3C controller: unexpected first frame with a 0x7F address when the I3C peripheral is enabled
I3C controller: no timestamp on IBI acknowledge when timing control is used in Asynchronous mode 0
I3C target: device returns incorrect value on read RSTACT CCC
I3C target: device can report target error 0 before dynamic address assignment
I3C target: nonparticipation in dynamic address procedure after NACKed hot- join request
I3C target: device fails to resynchronize with Sr or P condition in specific cases
Data corruption due to noisy receive line
USART does not generate DMA requests after setting/clearing DMAT bit
Received data may be corrupted upon clearing the ABREN bit
Noise error flag set while ONEBIT is set
LPUART does not generate DMA requests after setting/clearing DMAT bit
Possible LPUART transmitter issue when using low BRR[15:0] value
RDY output failure at high serial clock frequency
Truncation of SPI output signals after EOT event
TIFRE flag wrongly set in slave PCM long frame mode if FIXCH = 1
TIFRE flag never set in slave PCM/I2S mode if FIXCH = 0
Desynchronization under specific condition with edge filtering enabled
Tx FIFO messages inverted under specific buffer usage and priority setting
Buffer description table update completes after CTR interrupt triggers
TXHRST upon write data underflow corrupting the CRC of the next packet
Ordered set with multiple errors in a single K-code is reported as invalid
Missed CEC messages in normal receiving mode
Unexpected TXERR flag during a message transmission

tables.title: Document revision history
tables.text_helper: Table 5, "Document revision history", on page 34 of Rev 3.

rows: Document number corrected from ES0521 to ES0621. The information on the REV_ID[15:0] bitfield on the cover page updated. The summary table corrected in term of errata order. Added errata: •System: Invalid DAC output voltage for several DAC kernel clocks •LPTIM2_CH1 might prevent the system from entering low-power modes •CPU execution freeze upon first erase or program operation after power-on or wake-up from Standby •FDCAN TrustZone® protection not aligned with memory •Backup domain erased upon reset when STiRoT boot is active and the clock other than LSI selected •STiRoT fails if a tamper event arises during the startup •Tampers are not usable with STiRoT •FMC: CTB1, CTB2, MODE[2:0] write-only bitfields in FMC_SDCMR incorrectly described as read-write •OCTOSPI: Variable latency is not supported when a refresh collision occurs during a write access to some OctaRAM™ memories •In automatic status-polling and multiplexed modes, the controller does not request the port if less than two bytes are sent per cycle when OCTOSPI_DLR is cleared Modified System erratum LSE crystal oscillator may be disturbed by transitions on PC13. Removed errata: •System: Wrong control logic of Ethernet RX clock in sleep mode •FMC: Missing information on prohibited 0xFF value of NAND transaction wait timing •OCTOSPI: Deadlock can occur under certain conditions ™ •Automatic status-polling mode cannot be used with HyperFlash memories

Added errata: •PSSI: Output mode not usable with both PSSI_RDY and PSSI_DE signals enabled •SAES: Data transfer from TAMP_BKPxR to key registers must be done only in ascending order when KEYSEL[2:0] is set to 010 or 100 •TIM: Unexpected PWM output when using ocref_clr •RTC: RTC wrong calendar read value through shadow registers •I3C: I3C target: device returns incorrect value on read RSTACT CCC •I3C target: device can report target error 0 before dynamic address assignment •I3C target: nonparticipation in dynamic address procedure after NACKed hot-join request •I3C target: device fails to resynchronize with Sr or P condition in specific cases Modified errata: •System: LSE crystal oscillator may be disturbed by transitions on PC13 •SRAMx_RST option bits have an immediate effect •Incorrect backup domain reset •Backup domain erased upon reset when STiRoT boot is active and the clock other than LSI selected •STiRoT fails if a tamper event arises during the startup •Tampers are not usable with STiRoT
Removed OCTOSPI erratum In automatic status-polling and multiplexed modes, the controller does not request the port if less than two bytes are sent per cycle when OCTOSPI_DLR is cleared.
